name: walle
description: Collect, compact and sort the instruction files your coding agents load (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, skills, memory, Cursor and Copilot rules), find bloat, duplicates and drift, and measure their cost in real sessions

session_alarm.title: Session start alarm
session_alarm.description: At session start, add one line of context when the folder's instruction stack is over the budget. Never blocks.

budget_tokens.title: Stack budget (estimated tokens)
budget_tokens.description: Instruction stack size in bytes-v2 estimated tokens that triggers the alarm and fails `walle check`.
